key_concepts: FBX COMP imports geometry, animations, textures, cameras, lights, and scenes from FBX and related model formats into a component network.
Imported assets are cached as .tdc files in TDImportCache and read through Import Select TOP/SOP/CHOP operators.
Import Method controls whether import fully replaces, merges with existing contents, or reloads Import Select assets.
Most FBX page changes require a rebuild/update before the generated network reflects them.
Texture Directory helps resolve external texture paths when FBX files move between machines or were exported with absolute paths.
common_gotchas: Most FBX page changes are not applied until the FBX file is imported, rebuilt, or updated.
Full Replacement rebuilds the internal network and can delete manual edits inside the FBX COMP.
Merge with Existing is useful for relocated or changed assets but can still alter imported nodes.
Reload Assets updates Import Select assets without rebuilding the whole network.
External textures exported with absolute paths can fail after moving machines; use Texture Directory or embedded textures.
The TDImportCache .tdc file avoids re-import cost, but missing cache files require reopening the FBX to rebuild the cache.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ FBX scene import and cached asset workflow
